text:
Ana: hey folks - opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1427 (codename: emerald). Small change to JSON serialization for toolcall payloads to include content_type and to normalize streaming chunks. can someone take a look? wondering if this is a breaking change for any downstream clients. @sam @jia @mike
CI Bot: build #842 failed on `go test ./...` - panic in pkg/toolcall/serializer. log snippet:
```
--- FAIL: TestSerializeStream (0.01s)
serializer_test.go:42: unexpected nil pointer
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
```
Ana: ugh thanks - repro locally for me, pushing a small fix now.
Sam: I can take a look in ~30m, heads up I'm on call until 3pm PT so might be slow to respond.
Jia: quick skim: I think the change is fine for rest clients, but streaming clients need the chunk marker preserved. did you add a compatibility shim?
Ana: added a shim that falls back to legacy chunking when `content_type` missing. code snippet:
```
if payload.ContentType == "" {
  payload.ContentType = "application/json+stream"
}
```
Mike: I can review the Go bits, will check tests + edge cases. ping me if you need a faster review.
Mike: left two comments on the PR about nil checks and one test that assumes ordering, see comment: "TestStreamOrdering should allow reordering due to async flush"
Ana: pushed fixes addressing comments, adjusted test to be order-agnostic.
CI Bot: build #843 - all checks passing ✅ (linux/amd64, go1.20, js client)
Sam: LGTM, approving. :+1:
Jia: approve from me too. one minor doc nit but not blocking. :memo:
Mike: approved, looks good. suggest merging after 5pm PT to avoid traffic during morning deploy window.
Ana: thanks everyone — planning to merge at 17:10 PT unless anybody objects. merging will trigger canary rollouts for Dedicated and Hosted.
Sam: no objections.
Jia: no objections.
CI Bot: PR #1427 merged by Ana at 1976543425. deploy pipeline started: canary -> prod.
Ana: merged and monitor in progress, will post any rollback updates here. :rocket:
